zh-CN: 只用同一可观测量的 PLUMED 定版示例作设计参考。逐项核对原子索引、单位、PBC、CV 周期域、群组计数和归约。
PLUMED 2.9 COORDINATION 的两组用法给出成对切换权重之和；省略 GROUPB 时使用 GROUPA 的无序对。pyGAS CoordNum 按中心累加并输出逐原子向量。计算指定标记值时须核对配体选择、切换函数和最终取值。
PLUMED 默认距离为 nm、能量为 kJ/mol，可由 UNITS 修改。KAPPA 需要按能量与 CV 单位平方换算，并核对目标势函数前因子。METAD 的周期边界和历史格式须按目标实现核对。
若目标 pyGAS 图缺少科学定义所需的操作，明确这一点并讨论合适实现。
en: Use versioned PLUMED examples for the same observable. Check atom indexing, units, PBC, CV periodicity, group counting and reduction.

PLUMED 2.9 COORDINATION sums switching weights between the two atom groups. With no GROUPB it uses unordered pairs from GROUPA. pyGAS CoordNum accumulates a per-center vector. Check ligand selection, switch and the final selection or reduction when building a tagged CV.

PLUMED defaults to nm and kJ/mol and UNITS can change them. Convert KAPPA using energy per squared CV unit and check the target potential prefactor. Verify METAD periodic domains and history semantics in the target implementation.
When the target pyGAS graph lacks an operation required by the scientific definition, identify it and discuss a supported implementation.
